metadata.template_note: Wind ANALYSIS baseline for the in-process OpenSeesPy solver. The load case path, dt and duration are supplied only by the approval-frozen load Artifact; this template ships no bundled wind record on purpose. wind_load_mappings is always written by the dispatcher from the frozen target set, one entry per node, because the OpenSees wind module would otherwise fall back to applying the full target-set force at every node. Two frozen forms are accepted: a single total-force channel yields one mapping per node with an explicit equal weight all reading source_column 1, and one channel per target node yields per-node mappings with scale 1.0 and source_column i, applying each node's own force column at full magnitude.
